description.one_line_summary: A playful character badge hops with spring physics between selectable option cards.
description.detailed_description: During onboarding, selecting an option causes the animated character badge to spring and hop across to the selected card. The selected card lights up with a subtle gradient glow while a sample plays with character and wave animations.

motion_breakdown.end_state: The character rests centred on the newly selected card, playing its preview.
motion_breakdown.why_it_works: The hopping character turns a simple radio button selection into an engaging, embodied choice.
